acceptanceCriteria: A helper defined in a bound support module included by the spec group or by a bound config.include (optionally type-filtered) resolves, yielding RB-BLOCK-NEVER-YIELDED or clean; ambiguity still abstains; pinned by tests.
body: Residual of V1-1866/V1-1867 (PR #1166, head 8a21fb19c, GH #1163/#1164). Helpers defined in modules included via `include Mod` in a group or `config.include Mod` in spec_helper/rails_helper are not followed; RB-BLOCK-NEVER-YIELDED abstains as RB-HELPER-UNRESOLVED even when the module is bound and unique.
title: RSpec vacuous-expectation rules: follow module include / config.include helper definitions instead of RB-HELPER-UNRESOLVED
